pr_body:
The check of what filters can be pushed down was too strict leading to
 some queries to be evaluated outside the storage. This PR addresses the
 issue in particular is not null and is null filters.

Fix #103536
pr_title: ESQL: Improve pushdown of certain filters
pr_comment: Hi @costin, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment:
Okay, so now we're pushing per default rather than only in specific cases.

This could open up a lot more edge cases that may or may not be fully tested. Maybe let's run Luigi's monkey test on this change? (It's disabled per default AFAIK.)
